stage: Corrected before any learned training or held-out model evidence. Partial physical supervision fromv1 before the user preflight stop is preserved with provenance and checksum revalidation; no claims from it.

isolation.server: LabServer69 ~/rest_wl57; all scratch on /home; detached server-side chain
isolation.frozen: WL53-56 code and results, production FNTO, K44/DASQ, learned C, material/reference settings

representation.passivity: analytic zero-collision B plus learned scattered response on (1-beta) input; angular/spatial conditional probabilities and sigmoid survival; no oracle at runtime, energy clamps, damping or target normalization

data.geometry: r57_geometry.POSES frozen tuples: rest+12 train dents, 2 validation dents, 4 held-out dents (including WL56 centred dent); depths2-6mm/radii15-25mm/centres as committed
data.split: TRAIN/VAL/TEST exact lists in r57_geometry.py; no pose ID network input; test geometry never in gradient training or checkpoint choice

lights.families: face Gaussians, full-boundary Fourier/random/checkerboard, edge-decay near-contact profiles, equal-irradiance directional pairs; whole hidden boundary included
lights.semantics: nonnegative RGB cell/bin flux, independently normalized per channel; same material field on every geometry, no per-light state rebuild
lights.focused_population: First16 fixed top/bottom central Gaussians (centres grid +-20mm with seed-jitter, no dependence on current dent/target); test widths/seed disjoint. Last16 directional pairs. Gate1 concentrated fraction uses first16 only.

data.oracle: unchanged WL53 TR via WL55 sparse accumulator, 2048 photons/in-cell; first exit only. Existing rest5561/5562 and te0(dent)5565/5566 reused read-only. New poses seed 57700+10*index+rep; primary test poses second independent seed. cams=None (boundary-flux operator only).
data.targets: operator actions, not regression of individual noisy matrix entries. Evaluate 2.5mm/64 bins and aggregation to 2.5mm/16 bins and1cm/16 bins; original physical 3% composition rule unchanged

training.geometry_schedule: paired rest/current train geometry per step, deterministic shared order for D/R
training.optimizer: AdamW lr=.003 cosine to.00003, weight_decay1e-5, gradient norm clip1 (optimizer only)
training.loss: mean per-channel normalized action MSE: .5*(1cm,16out)+.5*(2.5mm,16out), plus .25 paired rest-to-current delta loss with denominator delta_L2^2 +(.01*rest_L2)^2
training.corrections: Only demonstrable implementation/numerical defects may be fixed with original evidence retained. No capacity growth, rank/support sweep, arbitrary retraining or alternative family after results.

gates.G1: nonnegative/passive reference, correct units/indexing/linearity; held-out aggregate edit signal/noise>=3 on>=3 of4 test poses and>=25% of their concentrated-light cases in at least2 channels. If meaningful signal cannot be resolved, stop before training, report noise. Assess independent seeds, never train on noisy individual entries.
gates.G2_G3_useful: For EACH test geometry and RGB, mean held-out relative L2 on1cm/16out<=.10 and p90<=.20; 2.5mm/16out mean<=.15; signed deformation delta relative L2<=.35 and corr>=.90 on independently detectable pose/channel cases. Report finer64bin metric and reference noise even when criteria fail.
gates.physics: zero<=1e-8, fixed-geometry linearity/superposition relative<=1e-5; no negative response (<-1e-8); analytical max column sum<=1+1e-6; repeated-cache output agreement<=1e-6; all runtime state from geometry/weights only
gates.directional: report equal-irradiance different-direction pairs against O; require differential relative L2<=.25 where O difference exceeds3seed noise. Never interpret equal total irradiance as identical input.
gates.G4_R_advantage: BOTH arms must meet useful and physics criteria. R error not worse than D by>.02 absolute relL2 on any primary geometry/channel (both seeds). R best-permitted-cache update+N query time <=.75 D on>=2 query counts including1or4; advantage exceeds timing uncertainty; cache memory<=1.25D and parameter ratio<=1.05. Else equivalence if accuracy within.02 and cost ratio[.8,1.25], otherwise conditional trade-off/no useful winner as measured.
gates.G5: Only useful+physical models enter coupled FNTO; evaluate model-vs-O, O-vs-Cycles, model-vs-Cycles separately on WL56 rest/dent near-contact scene; existing C/solve unchanged, current full scattered+ballistic bin readout plus analytic emitter; 3% physical rule not relaxed. If no model passes, skip expensive composition and report failed fidelity/validity gate, not architecture success.

cost.timing: 3 geometry/ballistic build repetitions, 5 warmups +20 query timings, CUDA fences, idle-GPU occupancy recorded; report medians and empirical intervals, all partial/full cache costs for D and R; best legitimate policy at each N; additionally 3 measured cache-build+N distinct-light lifecycle runs per policy/N; common geometry-build added separately, not hidden.
cost.scope: offline oracle/data generation and training separated from geometry update, first query, repeats and memory. No TR-to-learned speedup as R-vs-D evidence; no TransGI superiority.
cost.memory_accounting: Unique untyped-storage identity across geometry/state/coefficients/parameters, sparse indices+values included; views and aliases once; incremental and total cache allocations. Fresh process EACH model/seed/pose/cache policy; reset CUDA peak separately for cache construction, query and lifecycle; allocated/reserved and CPU RSS distinct. No geometry CPU copy used for GPU byte count.

composition: Existing WL56 upper centred dent te0+unchanged lower medium, fixed Lambertian source; primary face-on masks. No otop boundary comparison (WL56 invalid inside-medium camera). Historical O/C/solver and independent Cycles references retained, blue floor preserved. Candidate adapters isolated only.
reproducibility: Full code/protocol commit before primary targets/training; hardware/software, source/checkpoint/data/split hashes, samples, per-geometry/per-channel failures, runtime oracle-access audit and server-side status/logs retained; relevant WL53-56 focused regressions rerun.
stop: invalid/noisy target; oracle at runtime; broken K/C semantics; unmatched data; unfair caching only advantage; unrepairable physical failure; new representation class required; no WL58

amendments.reason: User requested focused preflight after static review. Preserve thresholds, split, R architecture, physical reference and photon/training budgets. Align D context, fix aliased memory and peak scope, add actual rigid-operator/resource/cache recovery controls.
amendments.auto_launch: Latest user instruction supersedes earlier preflight-only no-launch condition: final GO launches primary chain automatically.

resource_recovery.declared_before_primary: Three finite resource policies: default; checkpoint edge activations+32k edges+1M trace chunks+eval2; then8k edges+microbatch1 with exact batch2 accumulation+stream geometry+250k trace chunks+eval1. Same architecture, samples, steps, loss, split and criteria.
resource_recovery.checkpoint: Atomic training checkpoint every100steps plus firststep includes weights, AdamW, NumPy/Torch/CUDA RNG, history and step; restart latest complete checkpoint, preserve failed log+checkpoint. No best-of-attempt selection.
resource_recovery.reference: Atomic completed geometry/operator/actions reused. Smaller ray chunks can change deterministic random stream partition; realized chunk, seed and artifact SHA recorded; photon and within-bin sample counts unchanged. No retry selected by accuracy.
resource_recovery.failure: Only explicit CUDA allocation errors trigger bounded fallback; unknown errors or exhausted policies stop with FAILED and logs, no false COMPLETE. End-to-end attempt wall times include failed attempts. Disk shortage never triggers shared-file deletion.
resource_recovery.supervisor: Server PID/session independent of SSH. flock excludes duplicate chains; completed stage markers skip work after supervised restart. Fault-injection tests cover OOM retry, completed skip, unknown error and exhaustion.

causal_control.D: Raw140 geometry features plus fixed mean-neighbor140, second-hop140 and global-mean140=560. Same16-neighbor/two-hop and whole-domain information scope as R. Direct decoder hidden48/node74,160458parameters.
causal_control.R: Unchanged learned32-channel geometry graph state, two16-neighbor message layers plus global pooling; decoder hidden128/node144,162048parameters.
causal_control.interpretation: Tests this concrete learned nonlinear graph-state construction vs direct conditioning with matched context scope and fair caching. It does NOT isolate abstract state separation from nonlinear aggregation, inductive bias or parameter allocation. A positive result supports only this specific mechanism; no generic Rule-State adoption.
causal_control.no_sweep: One analytic parameter match before any model fit; no capacity selected on results, no third architecture. R unchanged; D context control repaired.
